description: Live checks for the all-Spark qwen-fast NVFP4, qwen BF16, and DSV4 Flash pipeline topology.

tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && for rank in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do ssh spark${rank} 'cd {repo}/v2 && NODE_RANK=${rank} HEAD_ADDR=spark0 NNODES=8 ./scripts/ds4_launch_qwen27_nvfp4_pp.sh' ; done && curl -fsS http://spark0:8103/v1/models
tasks.purpose: Launch one Qwen27 NVFP4 pipeline rank per Spark and prove spark0 exposes the OpenAI API.

tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && for rank in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do ssh spark${rank} 'cd {repo}/v2 && NODE_RANK=${rank} HEAD_ADDR=spark0 NNODES=8 ./scripts/ds4_launch_qwen27_bf16_pp.sh' ; done && curl -fsS http://spark0:8101/v1/models
tasks.purpose: Launch one Qwen27 BF16 pipeline rank per Spark and prove spark0 exposes the quality OpenAI API.

acceptance: startup logs show SimpleCPUOffloadConnector/native KV offload
startup logs show DeepSeek MTP speculative config
DSV4 precision and KV cache dtype remain mixed checkpoint/fp8 cache
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && for rank in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do ssh spark${rank} 'cd {repo}/v2 && NODE_RANK=${rank} HEAD_ADDR=spark0 NNODES=8 ./scripts/ds4_launch_dsv4_flash_pp.sh' ; done && curl -fsS http://spark0:8102/v1/models
tasks.purpose: Launch one DSV4 Flash pipeline rank per Spark while keeping the existing mixed FP4/FP8 + SimpleCPUOffload runtime path.

acceptance: submit response selected_nodes is spark0 only
each request status includes selected_node_ids spark0 through spark7
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli queue-submit --queue-dir /home/$USER/ds4_queue --profiles-dir profiles/models --topology profiles/topology/static_sparks.json --requests {requests_jsonl}
tasks.purpose: Prove all model requests enter through spark0 and bind to a pipeline service instead of a specific single-Spark worker lane.

acceptance: only one active compute lease exists for compute_domain spark-fleet-0 during a dispatch window
Qwen and DSV4 batches do not overlap compute leases
completed results retain service_id and compute_domain in selected_node metadata
requeue after transport failure preserves the pipeline binding
tasks.purpose: Prove the DS4 API layer, not the two vLLM instances, arbitrates the shared Spark compute domain.

acceptance: kv_shard_entries has one row per stage/node for a shared kv_cache_key
pipeline-status reports bytes grouped per node
legacy kv_entries is not populated for pipeline services
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli queue-status --queue-dir /home/$USER/ds4_queue && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli pipeline-status --queue-dir /home/$USER/ds4_queue --service-id qwen27_nvfp4_pp8
tasks.purpose: Prove logical KV entries are represented as one shard per pipeline stage instead of full replication to every possible worker.

acceptance: Qwen telemetry has 8 stages and layer ranges ending at 64
DSV4 telemetry has 8 stages and layer ranges ending at 43
reported kv_shard_bytes is node-local, not full logical KV size
tasks.purpose: Prove every rank reports only its local stage/layer subset and local KV shard usage.

acceptance: plan reports pipeline_parallel_size from the deployment file
each vllm node command carries the same VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION
operator can create a non-8 copy by changing worker_nodes, pipeline_parallel_size, and layer_partition together
tasks.purpose: Prove the planning layer is not hardcoded to 8 stages; non-8 deployments must supply matching nodes and layer_partition.
